roles.subject: Merlin, wise elderly man with a long silver beard and deep blue gold-embroidered hooded robes, holding a luminous blue crystal staff in a moonlit ruined observatory, subtle celestial charts, distant Avalon spires; sapphire and midnight blue, warm gold candle accents.

Percival, intense young adult male knight with neat straight brown bowl-cut fringe, bright teal eyes, short moustache and goatee, black high-collared armor and engraved silver details, a gold star brooch. Keep this specific recognizable hairstyle and facial hair. He stands holding his sheathed sword in a royal blue vaulted hall with a distant celestial window; steel blue, muted teal and antique gold, vigilant and heroic.

Loyal Servant of Arthur, warm handsome adult male knight with tousled brown hair and short beard, chainmail and royal blue cloak with gold fleur-de-lis brooch, one hand resting on an upright sword, castle courtyard at dawn; blue and muted golden light, steadfast and noble.

Morgana, pale regal sorceress with long flowing black curls and a gold crescent diadem set with a ruby, burgundy and black velvet high-collared gown. Purple magic curls from one raised hand, midnight castle and crescent moon behind her, wine red and restrained violet with antique gold, cunning elegance.

Assassin, rugged adult male in a black hood with subtle gold embroidery, scarred severe face partly lit and visible, black leather armor and muted crimson cloak, holding a single elegant dagger low by his side, dim castle passage with red torchlight, charcoal and deep crimson, quiet menace.

Oberon, gaunt otherworldly male outcast king with pale bark-like skin, long dark tangled hair, pointed ears, one glowing amber eye and a crown of branching black thorns with amber stone, layered ancient mossy robes. Twisted nocturnal forest, amber fireflies and grey green mist, isolated and uncanny.

Mordred, pale handsome young adult male dark prince with tousled black hair and tall black spiked crown, black engraved plate armor, heavy dark crimson cloak and antique gold chains. A dark sword held point downward, throne-room ruin behind, blood red light and black steel, cold commanding presence.

Minion of Mordred, weathered adult male henchman with coarse dark stubble, a stitched burgundy hood, rugged dark leather and chainmail armor with crossed straps. Holding a worn spear, smoky red-lit fortress rampart, embers far behind, deep rust and charcoal, hardened and watchful.

A second distinct Loyal Servant of Arthur: a brave young adult woman knight with copper-red braided hair, freckles, silver chainmail, royal blue cloak and gold fleur-de-lis clasp. Holds a blue heraldic shield at her side, dawn on the castle bridge, steadfast expression. Must look clearly different from the other loyal servants.

An East Asian male wandering swordsman integrated into the Avalon card deck: long loosely half-tied dark hair, angular face, sapphire-blue cross-collared tunic and cloak with antique-gold fleur-de-lis details, fitted leather and light engraved protective panels. A relaxed asymmetric three-quarter stance with a sheathed sword diagonally across his waist, in a warmly lit castle cloister. Rich painterly blue-and-gold rendering and close character framing match the other loyal servants.
